tools.name: arlo-design
tools.description: Generate electrical feeder assembly proposals through the local ARLO design worker. Proposals require separate engineering review and native verification.

tools.name: string-autofill-opt
tools.description: Runs the existing AutoFill target solver and records deterministic input/result hashes and source revision.

tools.name: count-modules
tools.description: Lists candidate module sets by layer and block. Select a listed set and optionally a design window to count one repeated design copy.

layer_shares.description: Return each layer share of the selected physical module total.

layer_share_above.description: With group_by layer, report and highlight each selected layer strictly above this percent of the selection. If ranked highlights are also requested, highlight only layers that meet both criteria.

layer_count_at_least.description: With group_by layer, highlight only selected layers at or above this physical module count. Apply other highlight filters to the same selection.

layer_names.description: Exact layer names for named panel selection.

cumulative_shares.description: Return running physical fractions in descending count order, ties by literal layer name.

coverage_percent.description: List every minimum-size layer set reaching this percentage of the selected module total.

rank_windows.description: Compare competition ranks in two to eight ordered world-XY windows using the same selected module sets. In series of three or more, list layers with a strictly improving rank at every step.

compare_selections.description: Compare exact block names or selected set IDs across two selections. Empty denominators yield undefined deltas.

top_layers.description: Rank layers by selected physical module count. Include ties at the requested cutoff.

highlight_ranked_layers.description: With top_layers, highlight only the ranked layers, including ties. Totals still cover the full selection.

panel_scope.description: For a layer breakdown, select explicitly panel-named blocks in this scope. Unknown candidate roles require a pick.

group_by.description: Break the selected physical module count down by drawing layer.

set_id.description: Single set identity from this drawing's listing. Omit to list sets.

set_ids.description: Choose the listed sets that together form the intended design.

region.description: Optional world-XY [minimum X, minimum Y, maximum X, maximum Y]. Counts fully contained individual INSERT bounds and eligible outlines. Overlapping boundaries and incomplete geometry refuse as ambiguous. INSERT arrays require whole-set counting.

tools.name: count-by-layer
tools.description: Counts every model-space entity per layer.

tools.name: measure-panel-area
tools.description: Sums closed-polyline area (total + per layer) in square feet; assumes 1 drawing unit = 1 inch.

tools.name: highlight-panels-near-edge
tools.description: Returns handles of polylines on a layer whose centroid is within a distance of the drawing extents edge.

distance.description: Max distance (drawing units / inches) from an extents edge.

tools.name: string-panels
tools.description: Bank-clustered, rotation-aware serpentine DC string routing over the Panels layer with an NEC 690.7 cold-temperature string-size check.

min_modules_per_string.description: Optional minimum modules per string. Enables bounded adjacency planning.

max_modules_per_string.description: Optional maximum modules per string, capped by the cold Voc limit. Enables bounded adjacency planning with minimum 1 when supplied alone.

voc.description: Module open-circuit voltage at STC, volts (demo default).

design_min_temp_c.description: Design minimum ambient temperature, degC (demo default).

max_system_voltage.description: NEC 690.7 maximum system voltage, volts (commercial-rooftop demo default).

panel_layer.description: Intake layer carrying the closed panel polylines.

cluster_radius_factor.description: Bank clustering radius as a multiple of the median nearest-neighbor panel distance; strings never cross bank gaps.

planning.description: Present for explicit module bounds. Status is complete, infeasible with a proof witness, or unresolved when the deterministic search budget is exhausted. Unsuccessful plans contain no strings.
